title: Run the managed preview with Node
responsibility: Starts the single managed preview with the runtime used by SvelteKit sync, then removes its temporary launcher on exit.

inputs.name: previewNode.args
inputs.description: Argument strings that previewArguments parses into the managed preview identity and port, then forwards unchanged to PreviewWorkerService. This function adds no argument schema validation before parsing.

outputs.name: previewNode
outputs.description: The promise resolves to 0 when the owner reports reuse or a signal-driven shutdown completes, and to 1 if that shutdown's cleanup fails. A newly started preview stays pending until SIGTERM or SIGINT; setup and startup failures reject instead.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error('Invalid preview ownership port.') when the selected owner port does not convert to an integer from 1024 through 65535, and Error('Could not prepare the managed preview runtime.') when Bun.build reports failure. Errors from argument parsing, owner or worker calls, Bun.build, filesystem setup or removal, and cleanup also propagate as rejections.
